messages:
anika: I opened a docs PR for a Dedicated capacity migration cheat-sheet: onboarding reserved pools, example account-labels, autoscale cooldowns, and clearer SLA copy. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2501. Quick reviews?

rachel: skimming now. Can we include a tiny TF snippet showing reserved_pool resource and the label/tenant mapping people copy/paste? Reviewers always ask for a runnable example.

mike: good call. I'll add TF and a minimal helm values example. Also we should show an autoscale policy sample with cooldowns + burst cap so infra teams don't misconfigure.

anika: sample autoscale YAML I drafted in the PR: ```yaml
autoscalePolicy:
  minInstances: 1
  maxInstances: 8
  scaleUpCooldown: 45s
  scaleDownCooldown: 240s
  maxBurstInstances: 2
```
Is that too aggressive?

rachel: looks fine for most workloads. Add a note: "use lower maxBurstInstances for latency-sensitive tenants."

docsbot: CI: lint OK. linkcheck: 1 outdated TF example -> repo moved (old path: /terraform-examples/dedicated/reserved_pool.tf). Suggested replacement path: /infra-samples/terraform/dedicated/reserved_pool.tf

mike: updated TF path and pushed a minimal example: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "acme" {
  account = "acme-corp"
  gpus = 2
  region = "us-west-2"
  labels = { env = "prod", team = "ml" }
}
```
Added a comment about preemption: burst instances are preemptible under host pressure.

anika: SLA copy options for legal: Option 1 (handbook): "99.9% monthly availability for Dedicated reserved pools during committed capacity windows, subject to documented exclusions." Option 2 (runbook): "Availability and latency targets with automatic fallback to compatible model variants and documented rollback steps." Which should we push to the handbook text?

legal: prefer Option 1 in the handbook but add explicit exclusions (force majeure, customer misconfiguration, scheduled maintenance with notice). Also include a short sentence limiting liability to service credits. Will sign-off once exclusions are in draft.

rachel: small SDK nit: Python snippet used old param name. Updated to v0.9.x API: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
res = client.dedicated.create_reservation(account_id='acme-corp', gpus=2, region='us-west-2')
print(res)
```
Added equivalent JS snippet too.

mike: I've added a short troubleshooting section for isolation edge-cases (cross-account labels, shared infra tags). Also flagged that "tenant" wording should be replaced with "account" in onboarding steps.

anika: thanks all. Remaining blockers: legal confirmation after exclusions added, and infra to confirm the playbook redirect exists (/docs/playbooks/dedicated-fallback). Mike, can you confirm the redirect?

mike: confirmed redirect exists. Once legal posts sign-off I'll merge. Adding PR checklist with owners: docs (anika), infra (mike), SDK (rachel), legal (legal).
